findings.summary: Dependents list omits the backtest test that reads the real docs/decisions.md; the D172 wording can break it
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs:114-132 (`the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list`) reads root/docs/decisions.md. It requires no phrase lacking a target, and requires `report.hits.len() == confirmed.links.len()`. crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs:79-81 matches "superseded by", "supersedes" and "amends" case-insensitively. Step 5 asks the Provenance to discuss the OLY-A-09 precedent and the follow-up wiring, and Decision 2 cites D162. A sentence such as "this amends nothing" or "D162 ... supersedes" adds an unconfirmed hit or a phrase with no target, and the test fails. The plan lists only the mirrors rules as readers of decisions.md. Fix: Add crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs (the real-log tests) to the dependents list, with test `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest`. In step 5, say that D172 must not use the words supersedes, superseded by or amends, or must add a matching [[link]] in docs/decision-links.toml if it really amends an entry.
findings.location: Plan: Dependents (docs/decisions.md gains entry D172), Step 5

findings.summary: Criterion 3 names the wrong seam for the decision-log mirror rules over the real file
findings.evidence: The athena-core mirrors unit tests run on temp fixtures (mirrors.rs:1900-1939 use `clean_tree`/`put`), not on the real docs/decisions.md. The rules run over the real repository in crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs:22-24 (`the_real_repo_has_no_mirror_drift`, `check_all(&root, &git_base(&root), None)`), and in the producer step through mirrors::check_all (run/producer.rs:86). `cargo test --locked` still covers it, but through a different test than the one cited. Fix: Name crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs `the_real_repo_has_no_mirror_drift` as the entry point for AppendOnly/DecisionEntries over the real decisions.md, in both the dependents list and the criterion 3 seam.

findings.summary: Adds a second DECISION_LOG constant beside an existing one
findings.evidence: crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs:7 already defines `const DECISION_LOG: &str = "docs/decisions.md";` for the decision gate. The plan adds `pub const DECISION_LOG` in design_surface.rs, so two constants in the same crate name the same path. Fix: Define the public constant once, in design_surface.rs or a shared place, and have run/checks.rs use it; or say why two constants are wanted.

findings.summary: Soundness: "touches docs/decisions.md" is weaker than what the existing decision gate requires
findings.evidence: The existing gate (run/checks.rs:21-51, `unreconciled` with base_log and cand_log) looks for a new entry in the log, not just a changed path. Under the plan, any edit to decisions.md silences the check for every surface change in the same change, for example a one-line append to an unrelated entry. This matches the accepted reading but leaves an obvious false negative. Fix: Keep the path rule as the accepted reading asks, but state the limit in the doc comment and in D172. Optionally add a later step that compares base and candidate logs for a new `## D` heading, as the gate does.

summary: I checked the plan against the code by reading it; I did not run anything. Its main claims hold. `diff` is at design_surface.rs:722, `kinds()` at 635, `KindDiff::total()` at 608 and the `tests` module at 773. `SurfaceInventory` derives Default and has public BTreeMap fields (athena-data records/design_surface.rs:12-28). OLY-A-12 is at spec.toml:1760-1766 with mechanism "none". `check_how_it_is_met` (spec.rs:194-213) accepts a measure ending `status: not shown`. D171 is the last entry, so D172 is the next id. The pure function, its three-outcome test and the `status: not shown` measure fit the accepted reading, and the criterion 2 test would fail if the body returned no findings. One reader is missing from the dependents list. crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs reads the real docs/decisions.md and fails when the new D172 text has a supersede/amend phrase that docs/decision-links.toml does not confirm. The criterion 3 demonstration also names the wrong seam for the decision-log mirror rules. The approach is sound for the accepted reading; two smaller soundness points are listed below.
